title: Eglin AFB diamond formation of orbs; Gaetz denied access to crew
summary: David Grusch tells of Eglin AFB diamond formation of orbs; Gaetz denied access to crew, about 2023 at Eglin Air Force Base, Florida, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: who was basically denied access to a crew that had seen kind of a diamond shaped formation of orbs.

plain: David Grusch, who speaks as a witness, says on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2023 that Matt Gaetz, a member of the US Congress, was turned away when he asked to speak with an aircrew at Eglin Air Force Base in Florida. According to Grusch, that crew had seen a diamond-shaped formation of glowing orbs. If true, it would mean even an elected lawmaker was blocked from hearing first-hand about such sightings.
